description.short: Go Below Underground Adventures is an award-winning, family-owned operator offering personally-guided expeditions through abandoned slate mines beneath the mountains of Eryri (Snowdonia). Four underground adventures range from a beginner-friendly half-day challenge to a full-day extreme descent to the deepest publicly accessible point in Great Britain — all running year-round, whatever the weather.
description.full:
Go Below Underground Adventures Ltd is a Betws-y-Coed-based operator offering four unique guided underground experiences within the historic slate mines of North Wales. The company is family-owned and award-winning, operating year-round regardless of weather conditions.

The original Go Below® Challenge (ages 10+, ~5 hours) takes participants on a scenic mountain hike to a hand-carved mine entrance, then through tunnels featuring zip lines, waterfall climbs, underground lake boat crossings, abseiling, and rock scrambling — no prior experience required.

Hero Xtreme (ages 14+, ~6 hours) ventures deep into Cwmorthin slate mine via suspension bridges, ledge traversals, zip lines spanning gaping voids, ladder climbs on towering chamber walls, and a lunch stop at the 'Xtreme Picnic Bench' — a seat bolted 120 feet up a chamber wall — before descending over 1,300 vertical feet to the deepest publicly accessible point in Great Britain.

The Ultimate Xtreme™ (ages 18+, ~7 hours) adds nine underground zip lines, the world's longest underground zip line 'Goliath' (130 metres, beneath 1,230 feet of solid rock), an optional 70-foot underground freefall with a mechanical braking system, via ferrata climbing, and five kilometres of mine workings.

For those seeking the most extreme experience of all, Deep Sleep places guests in underground cabins or a luxury grotto at 1,375 vertical feet — billed as the world's deepest underground accommodation. The 14-hour Mine to Mountain expedition combines underground adventure with an ascent to the mountain summit above.

All equipment (helmet, head torch, harness, and Wellington boots in sizes 1–12) is provided. The operator holds Adventure Activities Licensing Authority (AALA) accreditation and carries WTTC Safe Travels status. The company is rated 4.9/5 on TripAdvisor from nearly 1,900 reviews, and holds TripAdvisor Travelers' Choice 2026, ranking #1 of 17 outdoor activities in Betws-y-Coed.

fitnessRequirements.general: Participants must be 'reasonably fit' and able to sustain physical activity including substantial walking on steep, uneven terrain throughout the day. Persons who are very unfit, significantly overweight, pregnant, infirm, or anxious are advised not to book.
fitnessRequirements.medicalDisclosureRequired: Contact the office before booking if you have epilepsy, vertigo, mobility limitations, arm or leg strength limitations, amputations, deafness, sight impairment, or heart conditions. The operator states it is 'experienced in offering inclusive trips'.
fitnessRequirements.weightLimit: 19-stone maximum for the 70-foot freefall element of Ultimate Xtreme only. No general weight limit otherwise.

topThreeBlockers.blocker: World-record claims require attribution or independent verification
topThreeBlockers.detail: The operator asserts 'Goliath' is the world's longest and deepest underground zip line (130m / 426ft; 1,230ft below surface) and that Deep Sleep is the world's deepest underground accommodation (1,375ft). These claims are repeated across Visit Wales, Go North Wales, and TripAdvisor reviews, suggesting wide acceptance. topThreeBlockers.action: Use attributive language on the directory page: 'described by the operator as the world's longest underground zip line' and 'billed as the world's deepest underground accommodation'. If the human editor wishes to state these as verified facts, check https://www.guinnessworldrecords.com/ for a record entry under Go Below or Cwmorthin mine before publishing.
